what: Oshkosh makes heavy specialty vehicles: refuse trucks, concrete mixers, the JLG aerial work platforms, airport fire trucks and the next generation of United States Postal Service delivery vans.
customers: Municipalities, waste haulers, construction rental fleets, airports and the American government.
money: JLG boom lifts and scissor lifts
refuse trucks, fire apparatus and concrete mixers
military vehicles and the postal delivery vehicle programme
moat: Specialty vehicles built to order in small volumes, where the engineering and certification make the market unattractive to large truck manufacturers and impossible for newcomers.
risks: Aerial lift demand follows construction rental fleet spending, which is cyclical
The postal vehicle programme has faced political and funding uncertainty
opportunities: 17.3 times earnings and 8.6 times free cash flow with $974M of free cash flow
The vocational segment, refuse and fire trucks, has long order books and steady municipal demand
Analysts see about 16% upside, with 17 covering the stock
watch: Access segment orders and the vocational backlog.
